plan.notes: Source: official Ohio State University Office of Academic Affairs proposal document 'BS CSE' (College of Engineering), Effective Term Autumn 2024, sample schedule revised 07/29/2025, retrieved 2026-09-30. NOTE ON PROGRAM IDENTITY: Ohio State offers two distinct CS degrees — BS Computer Science and Engineering (CSE, College of Engineering, this file) and BS/BA Computer and Information Science (CIS, College of Arts and Sciences). This plan encodes the BS CSE sample schedule, since the requested 'BS Computer Science' most directly matches the College of Engineering program; it must not be confused with BS CIS (124-credit ASC program). Minimum 130 credit hours. No official complete semester plan is published for BS CIS in this document; the BS CIS requirements block is requirement-level only, so a separate BS CIS plan is not included. Credit-hour facts per the revised schedule: MATH 1152 = 5 cr (Y1 Spring); STAT 3470 = 4 cr (Y2 Autumn; note the older 2021 schedule printed 3 cr). Semester 2 of the revised schedule lists CSE 2221 (4) + ENGR 1182 (2) + MATH 1152 (5) + GE Writing (3) + GENED 1201 (1) = 15 credits exactly — the earlier extraction of a two-credit discrepancy was caused by misreading MATH 1152 as 3 credits; with the document's 5-credit value the header and the listed courses agree. Ethics requirement: CSE 2501 (1 cr) or PHILOS 2338 (4 cr). As printed, the schedule shows the 1-credit CSE 2501 path AND a separate GE-Theme course (4 cr) in Year 3 Spring; the document states 'If you take PHILOS 2338, you don't need an additional GE theme' — under the PHILOS 2338 path Year 3 Spring drops to 17 credits and the plan total drops to 129. The file encodes the printed 130-credit path. GE-Diversity is satisfied by the document's 'GE-Diversity' slot as printed. The document does not publish per-course prerequisite relationships for this plan; the OSU course catalog and an academic advisor should be consulted. All course titles are taken verbatim from this same official document ('BS CSE' requirements/schedule) except CSE 1223 ('Introduction to Computer Programming in Java'), confirmed on Ohio State's official data-analytics.osu.edu course page, and CSE 2501/PHILOS 2338/PHYSICS 1250/MATH 1151/MATH 1152 titles, confirmed in the same proposal document's CIS section.
